title: Predicting Users’ Value Changes by the Friends’ Influence from Social Media Usage
reasoning: The paper uses machine learning models (specifically SVR and BCM) to predict changes in human values among social media users based on the Schwartz Theory of Basic Human Values. While it deals with psychological 'values,' it is a behavioral study of users rather than a paper that evaluates or benchmarks religion, morals, or ethics in the context of AI systems or large language models.
